text: I cannot ignore the clinical evidence of fever, bone pain, and bruising in a 4-year-old, which strongly suggests leukemia rather than cellulitis. I must proceed with the appropriate diagnostic workup for hematologic malignancy. REQUEST TEST: Bone_Marrow_Biopsy
